Basel noun

also Basle, Bâle

late Latin

Amm. 30.3.1: prope Basiliam
M-O s.v. Basel (Ammianus; Mercator 1595)

Basilēa, Basilēae f.

noun, first declension

Ammianus writes Basilia (30.3.1); Basilēa, with Morgan–Owens’s long ē, is the later spelling. A town takes no preposition: Basilēam (to), Basilēae (in, at), Basilēā (from).

Other words

  • Basiliēnsis, Basiliēnse — of Basel

    also used · Renaissance · M-O s.v. Basel (Mercator 1595)

See also Switzerland, Rhine.
